main_text.p: monstravisse in quo solummodo est penetrabilis & mortalis. Altrinsecus in hoc confirmatus sum illud non esse (quod Plinius Junior dicebat de Regulo) Causæ Jugulum, in quod viri Clarissimi Larocca & Claudius inciderunt, si non elegerunt, quo impetito, debellarent Papam, & eâdem ruinâ, totum apparatum Romanensem everterent, diruerent: quanquam viri reverendi longè absunt à malis oratoribus de quibus loquitur Lucianus, quibus perinde est accipere; aut pro fronte suram, aut pro sura verticem: quia fieri potest, si Transubstantiatio est talus, ut Papa seu alter Achilles vulnere ex sagitta in eam partem adacta ab al-

page.notes: The text is set in a small roman with italic headline; some letters are blurred ("Altrinsecus" has an ink blot before A, "ruirent" reads "ruerent" or "diruerent"; "rui:rent" partly obscured). Words "Causæ Jugulum" and "Claudius" read as printed. The catchword "al-" is the hyphenated start of the next line, placed at the right below the last line. Page number "43" is read from a faint mark at upper right and is uncertain.
